_purpose: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the build toolchain versions this repository
pins. Originally (2026-08-06) this manifest was introduced as a pure
detector: every build script carried its own literal, this file enumerated
each site, and tools/test_toolchain_pin_consistency.py failed on any drift
between them. That changed the 2026-08-03 incident (one file moved to
3.44.8 while the other eleven stayed on 3.44.6) from silent into red.
On 2026-08-10 the refactor was COMPLETED by lane ds_flutterpin, so the
manifest stopped being a detector and became what it was designed for:
every declaration site now READS the value from this file at run time.
Shell scripts resolve it with read_wins_toolchain_pin (python3, key = e.g.
tools.flutter.version); PowerShell producers resolve it with
Read-WinsToolchainPin (ConvertFrom-Json). GitHub workflows are backup-only
refusal sentinels and must not resolve or consume toolchain pins. A literal that
happens to agree today is still a defect, because the next pin bump
silently desynchronises the site that carries it from every other build.
The next pin bump is now ONE edit: this file.
Because every site reads the file, the `sites` array below is INTENTIONALLY
empty. The guard still enforces three things that cannot be expressed by
'reading the pin': (1) a reintroduced bare literal anywhere in the scan
roots fails test_no_undeclared_pin_site_exists; (2) every Gradle wrapper
stays hash-pinned to the recorded distribution; (3) this file stays
internally well-formed. If a future build script needs the value, it must
READ this file; writing a literal to match it is what the guard rejects.

arm64_from_tag.note: Run on aione (aarch64) on 2026-10-15: git clone of the tag (commit checked equal to tools.flutter.revision), local branch stable, then bin/flutter --version (fetches the Dart SDK and builds the tool snapshot) and bin/flutter precache --linux --no-android --no-ios --no-web --no-macos --no-windows --no-fuchsia, with a private HOME and PUB_CACHE. Done twice in separate clean directories: every fetched file was byte-identical between the two runs; only the locally compiled bin/cache/flutter_tools.snapshot (app-jit), packages/flutter_tools/.dart_tool/package_config.json and .git pack files differed. Each URL above was fetched twice more directly (identical size and sha256 both times); every archive member is byte-identical in the run tree except three the tool rewrites by design (bin/cache/pkg/LICENSE.zip_old_location.md is the flutter_gpu.zip copy, and flutter_cache.dart removes gradle_wrapper NOTICE and gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties). The archive is run 1 without packages/flutter_tools/.dart_tool (absolute pub-cache paths; the producer treats it as runtime state), with the two reviewed links kept, packed deterministically (sorted, uid/gid 0, every mtime 1790805769 = the commit time, GNU tar, xz preset 6; two packs byte-identical). It binds run 1 bytes: the tool snapshot is not reproducible across runs.
